data_flows.purpose: user convenience: re-run past briefs, favorite names
data_flows.retention: until user deletes/clears; capped at 100 history entries per browser
data_flows.deletion_path: Dialog-confirmed per-item delete and clear-all; also IndexedDB quota eviction

data_flows.retention: lives on the user's device after download; not retained server-side

permissions: none — no browser permission APIs requested; camera/microphone/geolocation disabled by Permissions-Policy
cookie_storage_inventory: No cookies set by this app. localStorage key `delquro-theme` (dark|light). IndexedDB (via idb-keyval) keys `delquro:history:v1` (array ≤100), `delquro:prefs:v1` (theme + lastCriteria). All local-only, per-browser.
client_bundle_scan: passed — scanned .next/static/ for sk_live_, pk_live_, rk_live_, AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}, ghp_, github_pat_, xox[baprs]-, Bearer eyJ, AIza..., -----BEGIN — zero matches. Evidence: artifacts/evidence/sec-client-bundle.log
headers_csp: passed — Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security all set on every route; X-Powered-By removed. CSP uses 'unsafe-inline' for script-src (required for pre-hydration theme script) and style-src (Next.js inlined critical CSS); documented in docs/charter.md as an accepted trade-off against FOUC. Evidence: artifacts/evidence/smoke-headers.log and artifacts/evidence/headers-home.log
csrf: not-applicable — data_identity=local-only; no authenticated endpoints; no state-changing server routes exist (only GET /api/health). Would become required if authenticated cookie-based writes were ever added.
rate_limiting: not-applicable — no public auth/write/payment endpoints. GET /api/health is public read-only, returns a static object; name generation is 100% client-side (no server amplification). Would become required if the product adopted an online-first mode with public writes.
transport_security: HSTS header set (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains); effective only when served over TLS. In the Arena sandbox the preview is proxied over HTTPS by e2b. Local http://localhost:3000 is for development/preview only; a production deployment would terminate TLS at the hosting edge.
telemetry_review: none — no analytics SDK, no tracker, no RUM, no outbound fetch of any kind. Verified by grep for `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, analytics-vendor identifiers in app/lib/components — zero hits.
secret_scan: passed — no secret-scanner (trufflehog/gitleaks/detect-secrets) installed in sandbox; compensating control performed as a shell grep for sk_live_, pk_live_, AKIA..., ghp_, PEM BEGIN markers across source tree and shipped bundle; zero matches. Blocked for the recommended tooling until a scanner is added to CI. Evidence: artifacts/evidence/sec-client-bundle.log
dependency_review: frozen-lockfile install (npm ci) with package-lock.json integrity verification per POL-DEPS-012/U-02. 452 packages installed; no manifest/lockfile mismatch; no new deps added without charter update.
advisory_scan: passed (run) with 12 findings — 0 critical, 9 high, 3 moderate. Zero critical after upgrading next 15.5.23 → 15.5.27 this turn (closes GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36 Windows RCE + GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 AVIF image-opt RCE; neither was runtime-reachable because sandbox is Linux and the app ships no <Image>/image-optimization usage). Remaining findings are all transitive build/dev dependencies: postcss<=8.5.22 (via next's bundled copy), sharp<=0.35.4-rc.0 (next's optional image dep, unused), brace-expansion/braces/micromatch/fast-glob (via eslint-plugin-next build tooling), js-yaml (dev), @vitest/mocker/vitest (dev test runner). Fix path to zero would require next@16, which requires Node 22+; sandbox is Node 20.20.2 — accepted with a documented compensating control (bundle scan + runtime verification). Evidence: artifacts/evidence/sec-advisories.log
threat_model: see docs/threat-model.md — XSS (React text nodes, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML except static theme script), CSV DDE (sanitizer), storage corruption (Zod per-record), destructive actions (alertdialog), prototype pollution (strict schemas), DoS (quantity ≤50, maxAttempts bounded). No remote attack surface.

findings.status: accepted — build-only, non-runtime-reachable: postcss, sharp, brace-expansion, braces, micromatch, fast-glob, eslint-config-next, @next/eslint-plugin-next, js-yaml all transitive build/dev deps; next@16 upgrade requires Node 22+. Compensating control: client-bundle scan + no image pipeline + no outbound fetch.
accepted — vitest/@vitest/mocker path-traversal GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 is dev/test-only; never runs in production bundle; mitigation: tests use local fixtures only.
